source.label: STARCOP train/test CSVs + JPL AVIRIS-NG 2019 flight-line KML
source.method: tile row/col windows from the CSV ids interpolated inside the AVIRIS-NG flight-line polygons of the JPL 2019 KML

note: 3767 tiles (train+test) on 300 Permian Basin flight lines; position along a flight line assumes the KML polygon's first edge is line 0 (error bounded by the strip length). 1 tiles unmatched.
